title: Completion of the canonizer
statement: Let $c$ be an effective machine-coding scheme, and let $\alpha$ and $x$ be finite Boolean words. After exactly $3|\alpha|+4+T_c(|\alpha|)$ steps on the paired input $\langle\alpha,x\rangle$, where $T_c$ is the canonizer’s time bound, the prefix-parser–canonizer composition has halted, has output the serialization of the machine decoded from $\alpha$, and has its input head at position $2|\alpha|+3$.
replaced:
Let $c$ be an effective machine-coding scheme, and let $T_c(n)$ denote the time bound of
its canonizer. For any Boolean words $\alpha$ and $x$, after exactly
$3|\alpha|+4+T_c(|\alpha|)$ steps on the self-delimiting encoding of $(\alpha,x)$, the
buffered composition of the prefix parser and the canonizer has halted, has output the
serialization of the machine decoded from $\alpha$, and has its input head at position
$2|\alpha|+3$.
